name: Ayumi Podiatry
description: Ayumi Podiatry is a calm, accessible WordPress block theme designed for podiatry clinics, foot-care practices, and healthcare professionals supporting people who work on their feet. Built with quiet olive tones, clear sans typography, and an unhurried editorial structure, it presents clinical care, gait assessments, and transparent fee schedules with clarity. Fully compatible with the WordPress block editor and optional WooCommerce support, it offers dependable responsive layouts tailored for professional clinic websites.
